steps.content: [Desert - Daytime]

steps.speaker: Male Townsman
steps.content: That's right! This is Tuco!

steps.speaker: Male Townsman
steps.content: It's an oasis in the desert, a traveler's paradise, and the perfect vacation spot! No trip to WhiteSands is complete without visiting Tuco!

steps.speaker: Male Townsman
steps.content: Now, let me show you the grandest building in Tuco... The magnificent, unparalleled <color=#fb9259>Tuco Palace</color>!

steps.speaker: Young Boy
steps.content: Yeehaw!
[Tuco - Motel]

steps.speaker: Male Townsman
steps.content: So, what do you think? Impressed?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...This is the magnificent, unparalleled Tuco Palace...?
Hella looks up at the dilapidated building covered in cracks. The welcome sign overhead looks ready to fall at any moment. A little gray mouse pokes its head out from the sign, staring at her.

Looking down, a woman clutching a vihuela lies unconscious at the front entrance. In front of her are two suspicious figures, one with shifty eyes, and the other around Hella's age. They are striking strange poses.

steps.speaker: Motel Owner
steps.content: Welcome to <color=#fb9259>Tuco Motel</color>, my dear guest!
The Motel Owner's attitude is warm and friendly. She emphasizes the words "Tuco Motel" with particular clarity.

steps.speaker: Motel Owner
steps.content: I'm in charge of this place. Please call me Mira.

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: That big loudmouth is Wright, the town sheriff. The little loudmouth is Timmy, one of our Tuco kids.

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: They're not bad people. Just a little bit... odd.
Ignoring the man in the ill-fitting uniform muttering about the "grand desert hotel," Mira shuffles over and lowers her voice mysteriously.
Her gaze flickers and drifts toward Hella's side. Hella turns her head, just in time to see Korryn entering and ordering food like a regular.

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: They're actually quite honest, compared to some people.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You mean... her?

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: That's right. In WhiteSands, the ones you should be most wary of are bounty hunters. They only care about money, not people. Today they're your friend, tomorrow they could be after your life.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Jeez... are those bounty hunters really that despicable?

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: I have a friend who's a bounty hunter. She's been sneaky from a young age, and only hangs out with a lizard. She says that friends should always stick together, but in reality, if she sets her eyes on something, she'll snatch it by any means...
The description is so familiar. Hella just had a really bumpy trip with such a bounty hunter.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: That person wouldn't happen to also wear a white hat, would she?

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: Long hair, white hat, and a lizard.
Mira nods to each word.
A few meters away, Korryn turns her head, cheeks puffed with food. As she meets their gaze, she points at herself.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Ah?... Me?

steps.speaker: Drunken Woman
steps.content: Yes! You! It's... you!
The woman with that vihuela, who was lying unconscious by the front entrance earlier, suddenly stands up shakily and points a trembling finger at Korryn.

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: Oh no, Maggie's at it again...

steps.speaker: Maggie
steps.content: You promised me that we'll dine and dash together! You said that the signal was smashing a glass!

steps.speaker: Maggie
steps.content: But you left me behind! I was stuck washing dishes for a week be-be-before they finally let me go...!
She suddenly grabs Korryn and shakes her wildly.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Wait, wait... you've got the wrong person, it's not me...
The bounty hunter tries to argue, but her denial clearly triggers the drunkard even more.

steps.speaker: Maggie
steps.content: Lying again! You liar! You bastard!

steps.speaker: Maggie
steps.content: I won't let you go until you admit your crimes! I'll... keep watching, I'll keep...
The recently eaten food churns in Korryn's stomach as she gets violently shaken. She has to cover her mouth in agony.
Korryn closes her eyes, raising her hands in surrender.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Uh... ugh... stop, stop shaking me!

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: I admit it, I admit it was me, okay...? I just finished eating. I really don't want to throw up... ugh!
The drunken woman suddenly releases her grip, and Korryn, caught off guard, falls sideways from the chair and crashes hard onto the floor.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hahaha, what a dummy... hmm?
Her vision suddenly darkens, prompting Hella to look up.
She’s suddenly pulled into a warm embrace, the scent of alcohol, rich perfume, and exotic spices swirling around her, overwhelming her senses!
Maggie clings to the young girl. Tears stream down her face, but her hands are tightly wrapped around the girl's neck.

steps.speaker: Maggie
steps.content: Sob, you're so young, so naive. You can't let this wicked liar harm you!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: No... the person who messed with you is over there! Why the hell are you grabbing me...!

steps.speaker: Maggie
steps.content: Look at how cute you are... and your clothes are brand new! You're obviously an easy target...
Gasping for air, Hella's face twists as she desperately pries at Maggie's choking grip, calling for help.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Help, help! Let go of me! Korryn, Korryn!
Beside the struggling pair, Korryn lies curled up on the ground, clutching her stomach in agony, barely able to fend for herself.
Luckily, before Hella completely suffocates, the kind-hearted motel owner steps in.

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: Maggie! Let go!
The grip around her neck loosens. Hella finally breathes in some fresh air.

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: I'm really sorry, Maggie loses control whenever she drinks... This meal's on me, as an apology to you!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: (Pants) ...Oh?
Hella turns and locks eyes with the bounty hunter lying on the ground.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Seize the deal...!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...while it's on the table!
Reaching a consensus, the two little stinkers exchange knowing smiles.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Haha, you are too kind! I don't mind at all! We're all family here.
Korryn raises her arm, and her lizard obediently perches on the back of her hand. The lizard, Sheriff, starts "dancing" on her hand as she voices him like a ventriloquist.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: "Better accept graciously! Better accept graciously!"
There's nothing a free lunch can't fix. If there is, just throw in a cold drink with unlimited refills.
Tender steak paired with juicy cactus slices, followed by big gulps of icy mint tea... there's no greater comfort for Hella after a long day.
Drunken Maggie is already curled up asleep in the corner, finally bringing a rare quiet to the restaurant.
Korryn sips the last of her drink and crunches the ice in her mouth.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Now that we've escaped and had a proper meal, what's your next move?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Mmm... Borrow a car to find the Legion?

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Borrow a car?
Korryn lifts her chin and gestures for Hella to take in their surroundings. It's hard not to sigh at the sight of the shabby "Tuco Palace."

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Are you sure... there's a car here you can borrow?

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: Hehe, don't worry. We're remote, but there are local products that need to be taken to the market for sale. There are trucks around.

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: We rarely have out-of-town visitors. The townsfolk will be thrilled to see you...
Mira clears away the dishes and gets ready to take Hella to borrow a car...
...Until a sudden commotion erupts outside.

steps.speaker: Timmy
steps.content: Who... Who are you?!

steps.speaker: Timmy
steps.content: What did you do to the others?! Someone... help! Mmm! Help...
Where are those two wenches?! If you don't speak up, I'll crush you too!
Hella recognizes the intruder's voice and jumps up from her chair.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: It's those desert bandits! They found us!
